integrity: Proof uses exact Walsh orthogonality, invertible even-dimension diagonal convolution, explicit real Gram lateration, and a dimension-three-spacing counterexample. A reproducible finite checker is included; independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proves generic conjugate recovery for even Boolean dimensions and unconditional recovery only in the four-dimensional n=2 case. Does not characterize odd dimensions, noisy stability, or all exceptional signals. Literature originality review bounded.
title: Generic conjugate recovery from a Boolean-star Walsh window
